rank_policy: Higher-is-better within the same eligible cross section; midrank percentile (average rank minus1)/(N-1), N1=>0.5. Equal-weight signal percentiles for composite; stable security_id ascending breaks selection ties. Precomputed rank stream, no learned weights.
matched_policy: At each decision, all families and eligible-universe benchmark use the same certified union of required 365-day price and90-day insider prerequisites. Genuine zero retained only with certified coverage; unavailable excluded and counted. No insider-presence-only survivor panel.
insider_definition: Distinct stable owner CIK among active nonderivative P/A positive-share events, firstAvailableAt within30/90 days; private purchases included; future corrections cannot change historical state.
momentum_definition: 180/365 elapsed calendar-day split-safe price ratio minus1 using completed bars; only splits effective within compared bars; not total-return prices plus cash dividends.
benchmarks: Explicit SPY buy-and-hold, proposed implementation pending freeze
Equal-weight entire matched eligible universe, monthly; not top20/40
inference: Paired mean net excess and separate RF0 Sharpe difference vs same momentum horizon/holdings; insider window does not create duplicate momentum trials. Both directional effects must be positive; drawdown alone insufficient.
metric_contract: True NY closes; simple adjacent daily returns; rf0;252;sampleSD;MAR0 all-return downside RMS; period running-peak drawdown;25000 initial funding.
freeze_blockers: Certified insider coverage and genuine zeros
Production compiled stream bindings and empty-universe execution evidence
shortfall_policy: Select min(N,K); nominal per-name allocation95/K percent, total deployment95*min(N,K)/K; equal selected weights, remainder cash. N0=>cash-only/liquidate at monthly decision; empty-universe server behavior remains untested. Never broaden universe.
selection_policy: Scheduled participation>=90% in EACH active scored fold. Count an intended decision only when complete certified inputs, guards and rebalance evaluation exist; cash-only N0 does not count. Require positive pooled paired daily mean excess AND pooled separate zero-RF Sharpe difference, positive median fold mean excess, and no critical failure. Rank eligible composite cells by highest median fold paired mean excess, then lower neighbor effect dispersion, lower mean traded-notional fraction, then ascending(momentum,insider,K).
aggregation: Align unique scored dates strategy/control, concatenate held-out fold returns only, no training/warmup returns and no duplicate dates. Pooled mean=mean paired differences; Sharpe difference=separate RF0 sampleSD Sharpes of pooled strategy/control returns. Training may select nothing with held-out data; final Development configuration selected after all predeclared fold evidence.
stability: Three Hamming-distance-one neighbors per composite cell. Report incremental means and Sharpes, fold signs and population SD of pooled neighbor mean excess (tie-break dispersion); flag isolated positive maximum if all neighbors fail directional conditions. Never switch winner retrospectively.
